description:
[Merchant] Generate an asynchronous data report for merchant data analysis and reporting. Production only - not supported in sandbox.

⚠️ **Running a report is entitlement-checked as of 2026-08-22.** Naming a report answers **403
`ERR_REPORT_NOT_AVAILABLE`** when that report is not included in the caller's plan or partner type.
Until that date only the *menu* was filtered - the door was not - so a caller that hard-coded a
report id it had never been offered could still run it, and may now start failing.

**Always resolve the id from `payware_data_list_reports` rather than hard-coding one.** That call
and this check share a single rule, so the menu and the door cannot drift apart: if a report is in
that list, this call will accept it.

Distinguish the two failures:
- **403 `ERR_REPORT_NOT_AVAILABLE`** - the report exists, this caller may not run it. Not retryable;
  it is a plan boundary, not a transient error.
- **404 `ERR_REPORT_UNIT_ID_NOT_FOUND`** - no report is registered under that id at all. Usually a
  typo or a stale id.

For an ISV acting on behalf of a merchant, the plan that applies is the **merchant's**, and reports
are outside the Basic plan entirely.

dateFrom.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD), with period CUSTOM or no period. Ignored with any other preset.

dateTo.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD), with period CUSTOM or no period. Only an end date covers that one day; no end on a range is today.

ignorePagination.description: If true, return report as single continuous document. If false, paginate results.

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

period.description: Period preset: TODAY, YESTERDAY, THIS_WEEK, LAST_WEEK, THIS_MONTH, LAST_MONTH, THIS_QUARTER, LAST_QUARTER, THIS_YEAR, LAST_YEAR, or CUSTOM with dateFrom (and dateTo for a range). Which presets a report takes is its `period` in payware_data_list_reports. Omitted with dates is CUSTOM; omitted without dates is today, or the last closed month or quarter for a statement. Every preset is open on every plan; a custom range needs Standard or above (ERR_REPORT_CUSTOM_RANGE_NOT_IN_PLAN).

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication. Uses production private key as default (Data API is production-only).

reportUnitId.description: The ID of the report to generate

name: payware_data_generate_report
